text: Seed 21 at N=256 starts gaining force margin at step 1500 in the 12000-step run but only at step 3500 in the 6000-step run, with the same config otherwise. Is the timing of force onset at N=256 set by the lr schedule horizon, or does it vary from run to run even at a fixed seed? Two identical reruns of the 12000-step seed-21 config would tell these apart.
